packs.title: Theme Parks and Green Escapes
packs.promise: Explore Orlando’s theme-park landmarks, science, wildlife and gardens across separate outings.

q.s: Make an original design from water and architecture.
st: Choose a permitted stationary viewpoint clear of others.
Notice a roofline and its relationship to the water.
Draw or describe a new composition that changes both shapes.

q.s: Notice how a designed street suggests a setting.
st: Use current guest maps and stay in open public guest areas.
Find three architectural details that suggest different building uses.
Describe which detail communicates most clearly.

q.s: Turn a designed landscape into a short arrival story.
st: Find an open guest position away from queues.
Notice one curved form and a relationship between planting and architecture. Imagine a gateway that rearranges them.
Give your gateway an original name and write a two-sentence arrival story: what someone notices first, then what the entrance reveals. Work the curve and planting into your story.

packs.title: Downtown to Lake Eola
packs.promise: Follow downtown details from historic storefronts to a lakeside pause.

q.s: Find small variations in a patterned facade.
st: Find a repeated line, a contrasting texture and a small decorative shape.
Choose the detail you would otherwise have missed.

q.s: Turn an architectural detail into a new arrangement.
st: Notice two exterior lines or shapes from the sidewalk.
Draw or describe a pattern that changes the size and arrangement of both shapes.
Give the resulting pattern your own original title.

q.s: Observe the museum’s public setting before any visit inside.
st: Stay on the public approach and leave entrances clear.
Find a straight line, a curved detail and a change of material.
Record which belongs to the building and which to its surroundings.
